response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS status, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_model_confidence FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), overall_reference AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS overall_avg FROM compliancecase), qualifying AS (SELECT s.status, s.avg_model_confidence, r.overall_avg FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_reference AS r WHERE s.avg_model_confidence > r.overall_avg), qualifying_reference AS (SELECT AVG(avg_model_confidence) AS qualifying_avg FROM qualifying) SELECT q.status, q.avg_model_confidence, q.avg_model_confidence - q.overall_avg AS amount_above_average, q.avg_model_confidence / qr.qualifying_avg AS ratio_to_qualifying_average FROM qualifying AS q CROSS JOIN qualifying_reference AS qr WHERE qr.qualifying_avg IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: “Above-average” compares each status average with the average across all cases with a model confidence value.

alternatives.interpretation: “Above-average” compares each status average with the mean of all status averages, giving each status equal weight.
